negative_stage_series_path: LTC4261 VEE and upstream Kelvin shunt terminal
Kelvin current shunt to external N-channel SOURCE
external N-channel DRAIN to original protected negative net
ALL original protected bulk and external load remain downstream

controller_standalone_controls.ON: isolated RUN: HIGH starts, LOW stops; local 47k pulldown to VEE
controller_standalone_controls.EN: VEE for enable, or separately proved default-HIGH inhibit; NEVER use ISO7710F default-LOW as an active-low EN permit
controller_standalone_controls.UVH_UVL_OV: actual AGND-to-VEE rail measurement, with complete divider/error/partial-power proof still required
controller_standalone_controls.PGI: VEE if unused; internal PGI watchdog is not credited as the independent startup deadline
controller_standalone_controls.DRAIN: protected output via manufacturer 1Mohm connection; pin clamp current below2mA
controller_standalone_controls.RAMP: CR to protected drain; RF/CF noise filter with RF*CR<=50us and CF>=3*CR at required effective corners
controller_standalone_controls.SS: separately selected small CSS, including full charge/discharge in timing proof
controller_standalone_controls.TMR: separately selected CTMR; native debounce/PG timing must not restart the external watchdog
controller_standalone_controls.PG: informational only: internally latched low-VDS indication is NOT live absolute output-valid
controller_standalone_controls.SDAI_SCL: pull to local INTVCC if unused; no live MCU/I2C path assumed
controller_standalone_controls.all_unused_pins: bind explicitly per package pin-functions table; never infer from the QFN pin numbers

independent_protection.watchdog_supply: existing AUX, with its own supervised valid signal and local decoupling
independent_protection.watchdog_arming: Hold stage RUN LOW. Enable watchdog and wait for ENOUT and WDO HIGH; primary reset release170..230ms is NOT included in the20ms post-RUN receiving reserve. A single accepted WDI falling edge coincident with latched RUN establishes deadline epoch. No further WDI edges during STARTING.
independent_protection.watchdog_disable: Only latched COMPLETED plus live independent absolute READY may disable watchdog. Any subsequent absolute-voltage loss asynchronously clears RUN and latches FAULT; READY chatter cannot rearm or pet watchdog.
independent_protection.fault_latch: WDO LOW sets persistent hardware FAULT. AUX-invalid, absolute source invalid, controller fault or requested stop asynchronously clear RUN. New attempt requires explicit OFF/reset action after source and protected output are safe; no periodic autoretry.
independent_protection.primary_fail_off: ISO7710F default-LOW output drives ON. Use one independent output per stage and a real AUX-to5V translator; exact translator and its partial-power behavior remain unselected.
independent_protection.secondary_fail_off: FAULT also removes retained B2B bank permit; loaded Si8751/B2B turn-off must be measured/bounded. Optional local UCC27511A sink-only clamp is a candidate, not accepted by a1mA invented IQ guarantee.
independent_protection.native_controller_peak_limit: 45..55mV table over required current shunt. Native620us circuit-breaker delay is measured unloaded; no loaded fault-time or250mV peak-current guarantee inferred.

floating_bias.switch_candidate: BSS84AK, discrete P-channel oriented so its body diode blocks positive-source feed when OFF
floating_bias.enable: independent actual AFTER-BANK absolute UV plus AUX-valid plus bank permit; defaults OFF even if negative rail absent
floating_bias.partial_power: VIN/INTVCC UVLO is insufficient because positive guard could keep the floating controller alive after negative source disappears. Bias path off-leakage, turn-off delay and VEE minimum effective capacitor are explicit receiving conditions, not manufacturer guarantees.
floating_bias.load_side_collapse: Preserve reverse blocking and analyze charged load/body diode/cross-rail paths, every input clamp, capacitor displacement and gate residual charge; simplified positive-VEE calculation is not a complete bound.

state_contract.OFF: RUN LOW; bias OFF unless source-valid test phase explicitly enabled; B2B default OFF; FAULT cannot self-reset
state_contract.ARMING: source LDO stays ON; enable B2B while downstream pass remains OFF, verify actual after-bank UV, enable floating bias, wait valid bias and watchdog ENOUT/WDO. No bulk charge admitted yet.
state_contract.STARTING: latched RUN plus one WDI falling edge; one bipolar stage at a time after positive5V banks fully charged; full external load remains present from0V; external deadline is never paused by controller UV restart
state_contract.ON: independent live absolute output valid and debounced completion; disable startup watchdog only through latched COMPLETED
state_contract.FAULT: immediately revoke isolated RUN and B2B permit and switch bias OFF through specified fail-off paths; latched until explicit safe OFF/reset; fault energy includes finite turn-off and stored-source energy
